description: Lockheed F-80C Shooting Star mounted on a pylon in the Parque del Avión, painted as FAP 154; the aircraft's true identity is unverified so the serial is left blank. Photographed in place August 2023; park still featured in 2026 videos. A bust of Cap. Quiñones stands in the same park.
aliases: Shooting Star; P-80; P80; 154; F80C; F80
museum_name: Parque del Avión F-80 Monument, Rímac
